claims.claim: Starting soon, any ad in Pennsylvania that uses AI to change or create images, video, audio, or text must clearly say so.
claims.episode_span: Starting soon, any ad in Pennsylvania that uses AI to change or create images, video, audio, or text must clearly say so.
claims.supporting_quote: The law requires any ad - whether it's a still image, video, audio, or text - that "has been significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence" to include a label
